◉ Urban Heat Atlas

Data credits and licenses

Federal data

  • NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, U.S. Climate Normals 1991–2020. Annual and seasonal station normals, version 1.0.1. The atlas derives urban and rural comparisons from these data.
  • U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Cartographic Boundary Files. Original 2020 urban-area boundaries classify station locations. The state basemap uses Census geography distributed by us-atlas.

The atlas is an independent analysis of federal data. NOAA and the U.S. Census Bureau do not endorse the project.
